desc:
Marketplace account management starts best with a short, clear first round of work. In this starter sprint, Ecom Swift LLC checks your account health, reviews your listings and orders, makes the updates that matter and reports what we found.

## What is a marketplace management starter sprint?

A management starter sprint is a fixed, short piece of hands-on account work that shows what regular management would involve. We look at your seller account the way a manager would on a first day: metrics, listings, stock, prices, messages and advertising settings. We fix what is quick to fix and write down the rest.

Monthly management is a separate arrangement. It is quoted after the sprint, based on your catalog size and order volume.

## Why an account needs regular attention

A marketplace account changes every day, even when you do nothing. Listings go out of stock, competitors change prices, buyers leave messages and metrics move. A small problem left alone, such as a few late shipments or an unanswered message, can grow into a warning.

Many sellers also run the account in the gaps between other work. That is understandable, yet it leaves outdated titles, forgotten promotions and neglected reviews that are easy to fix once someone looks.

## How a first sprint helps results

Management improves results by catching problems early and keeping listings current. A listing that is in stock, correctly priced and clearly written is easier to sell than one that is not. Quick replies to messages protect your response metrics. Reviewing advertising settings can show spend that is not working.

The sprint gives you evidence. You see what we changed and what it affected, and then you decide whether ongoing support suits you. We do not promise a rise in sales, because that depends on products, pricing and competition.

## What the sprint can cover

- Account health and performance metrics, read in plain terms.
- A review of your listings for errors, thin content and missing attributes.
- Quick fixes to titles, bullets, images and categories.
- A check on stock levels against what you actually hold.
- A price check against close competitors.
- A look at customer messages and review responses.
- A review of advertising settings, in the larger package.
- A written report with what changed and what to do next.
- A plan and quote for monthly care, if you want it.

## How we work

We start with an access setup, then read your metrics and listings before changing anything. We sort the issues into quick wins, medium jobs and decisions that need you. Then we make the agreed updates in your account and record each one.

The Basic package covers a health check, a review of key listings, a few quick fixes and a short report. Standard widens the review and adds more updates, a stock and price check and a look at messages and reviews. Premium packs a broader first round into one sprint, with advertising settings, a written report with results and a plan for monthly work.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your main goals for the account before we start.
- Share any warnings or notices you have already received.
- Decide in advance which changes you want to approve first.
- Keep your own notes on pricing rules we should respect.
- Look over the report and raise any question you have about it.

**Avoid:**
- Changing the same listings yourself while we work on them.
- Expecting every problem to be fixed in one round.
- Giving more account permissions than the work needs.
- Ignoring the next steps list once the sprint ends.
- Treating the sprint as a replacement for daily order handling.

## Who it is for

A seller who has been too busy to look closely at the account and wants a clear picture. A business that has just inherited or bought a marketplace account. A founder deciding whether to hire a manager or keep the work in house.

## What we need from you

Add us as a user with the permissions the work requires, such as listings, inventory and reports. We never need your password, and you can remove our access whenever you choose. Send a short note on your goals and any known problems.
